# Historical and Relational Branches

The [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains `6 / 6′ → 6+6′` and its six generated relations. The protected [HISTORY](HISTORY.md) is the received lexical and historical carrier. This branch develops the differences needed when those words return from legal, psychic, philosophical and technical uses. Historical descent, attested sense, authorial operation and poetic re-entry keep separate warrants.

## Witness, weighing and the authority to decide

The protected word record places Latin *arbiter* within a field of beholding, hearing, witnessing and judgment, and *arbitrari* within perception, consideration, weighing and decision. These are several offices carried by a word-field. A witness supplies an encountered particular; weighing assesses its force; judgment states what follows; an authorised decision gives that judgment consequence. A person can perform more than one office, but their conjunction does not make testimony self-authorising or every act of perception an adjudication.

[Lewis and Short’s selected entries](../../sources/classical-philology/lewis-short/lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary/lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary.md#lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary-q004) **source** observation, consideration, judicial decision and testimony as differentiated Latin uses. The *arbiter* entry separately names witnessing and an appointed deciding office. Its deeper going/coming reconstruction remains a historical dictionary claim requiring specialist review; the semantic relation can be used without adopting that reconstruction. [LSJ’s κρίσις entry](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q004) **sources** separating, judging, choice and judicial proceedings, with its own Greek citation chain.

The exact **fidem alicui arbitrari** construction is now verified in Lewis and Short, *arbitror* II.A, citing Plautus, *Bacchides* 3.6.41. Its office is credit accorded to someone. This is a recovered dictionary witness; the continuous dramatic passage and selected Plautus edition remain independently uncollated. The authorial relation remains explicit: **Fides is prior to arbitration; Credere is what becomes possible again after arbitration. Arbitration is what happens when trust can no longer remain tacit.** The [Fides field](../trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains its whole cycle; the present field retains the act in crisis.

A pledge differs from a score of credibility. In [Murray's Homer source, q008](../../sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/homer-1919-odyssey-murray.md#homer-1919-odyssey-murray-q008), Poseidon's undertaking moves from a demand to release Ares toward his own liability if Ares flees the debt, and Hephaestus releases the bonds. The source card records *Odyssey* 8.344–66, with wording verified on the public Murray surface and Perseus reread pending. The narrated undertaking distinguishes surety, debt and release. The Latin phrase is not its translation, and the institutional classification of the Homeric exchange requires its separately declared Greek-law source.

## Measure, excess and an office claiming its source

[LSJ’s initial *hybris* sense](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q005) **sources** overbearing violence and insolence, with the Odyssey suitors among its cited witnesses. E2's exact appointment is authorial: **a local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition**. The lexical field and the theorem therefore have different tasks. A contextual Greek passage can establish who acts against whom and what the act is called; it cannot by itself establish every modern instance of source-usurpation. Conversely, the exact QL relation does not certify a Greek legal usage.

The institutional branch requires an identifiable deciding office, rule of admission, means of enforcement and affected party. Arbitration, adjudication and governance differ in scale and authority. A judgment can state a warranted result without the speaker having power to enforce it; administration can enforce a rule without having originated the rule; apportionment can distribute shares and burdens under a measure whose source remains contested. The historically significant question is where those powers were joined, divided or revised in a particular institution.

The [Prisoner source](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner.md) offers a developed political Mytheme with a declared medium and date, British television in 1967–68. The changing Number Two preserves an administrative office; Number Six fixes an unwilling person as its classified object. Answering Six's question about One by assigning Six his number makes the source of classification inaccessible within the classification. The finale's inward return does not make the Village's coercion imaginary. This is a source-specific dramatic comparison, not evidence of a universal priest-to-king-to-politician sequence.

The [language, law and nation history](../../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/HISTORY.md) retains the distinct questions of standardisation, jurisdiction, belonging and administrative classification. Each concrete leaf needs its own persons, dates, documents, institutions and affected-language witnesses. A category becoming enforceable is different from a word becoming common. The E2 operation travels between them only when the transformation and consequence are stated.

The [language–law–nation development](../../histories/places-and-peoples/language-law-nation-centralisation/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** the deciding office through twelve situated branches. A language’s judicial standing, the work of translation and the exclusions of an inherited national alignment can have different histories. At register 3, the consequence must reach the authority able to alter its criterion; one document’s language rule does not certify every branch’s enforcement.

## Regard: the look reaches what can revise it

The protected word record places French *regarder* and English *regard* in looking, observation, notice, heed, consideration, respect and relation. [TLFi’s French entry](../../sources/language-literary-studies/atilf/atilf-tlfi-regard/atilf-tlfi-regard.md#atilf-tlfi-regard-q001) **sources** a differentiated chronology: ocular use, attentive consideration, inspection and administrative control receive separate dated witnesses. Its fountain-inspection opening keeps a material use available alongside interpersonal attention. These dates remain mediated through the lexicon’s cited editions. Anglo-French transmission and English dating still require their separate witnesses. The sequence of generated relations is not a claim that historical speakers traversed a QL circuit whenever they used the word.

**Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** gives Regard its authorial operation: a judgment becomes answerable to the field that bears it. Context includes the observer's investment as well as what is observed. A disclosure can be exhaustive in detail while excluding the authority that determines which details matter. Regard has reached the relevant depth when the disclosed relation can affect that authority.

[Gebser's selected source](../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) supplies the historical-optical and integral branch through its mapped passage ranges. Perspective achieves determinate placement and representation; aperspectivity releases its exclusive claim through the co-presence of structures. Taylor's P5 carrier makes body, concern, text/subtext and the absent-Father/surrogate-standard pressure explicit. These are distinct source and authorial contributions. Gebser's exact selected-edition quotations remain locator-needed.

The [Watson source chain](../../sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md) retains a further distinction. Watson's 1996 thesis pp. 112–13 transmit Gans's 1988 chapter on Levinas and Pontalis; the selected 1998 book has not yet been collated at those passages. The Gans wording remains double transmission until the chapter is read directly. The separately checked Lingis passages at pp. 50 and 197–98 concern the Other exceeding the idea held of them and an encounter incommensurate with the exercise of power. They give the ethical return its resistance to appropriation, with edition collation still owed.

This is not merely more knowledge about someone. The encounter can change the economy through which satisfaction or correctness is determined. Watson's comparison also retains Levinas's reservation about an ontological priority that remains theoretical rather than face-to-face. A future Heidegger–Levinas comparison must preserve that disagreement; the terms cannot become synonyms for one enlarged view.

The [language, symbol and dialogue history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/HISTORY.md) is the route for the particular media, practices and institutions through which such address becomes possible. [A31](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) receives its technical consequence: another participant must have a place from which to change the answer, task, model, evaluator or commission. The presence of an explanation alone proves none of those changes.

The [language and dialogue development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md) **extends** Regard at register 3 through the reply that can change interpretation. Lacan’s address and Bohm’s suspended assumptions have different practices and sources. The return concerns a changed hearing or question, not merely another utterance recorded beneath the same frame.

## Anamnesis, recognition and a history which remains effective

Greek *anamnesis* retains the protected record's field of recollection and calling to mind. The [LSJ recollection entry](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q006) **sources** the verified lexical range, with Phaedo 72e and 92d and Philebus 34c as dictionary-cited Platonic locators. These contexts remain to be independently collated before assigning recollection its function in a particular Platonic argument. The lexical witness and Taylor's source-return operation retain their distinct registers.

The relation to Śaiva recognition has another source task. [C19](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) preserves the distinction between retained traces recalled within a contracted field and recognition of source-relation, with the Dyczkowski pp. 71–75 collation still identified. Pratyabhijñā is not an alternative spelling of Greek anamnesis. [A21](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) and [C34](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C34-Individuation.md) preserve the psychic distinction between recognition, integration and individuation: coordination of agencies, re-situation of conflict, and changed relation to provenance do not collapse into one act.

Frank's [Van Eenwyk encounter](../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md), particularly the protected notes around pp. 65–73, supplies the known→unknown→known pressure. Symbols can alter the organisation through which an encounter is understood. The book's SOURCE currently has no gathered excerpt, so copied quotations remain leads. [Symbolon Dynamics](../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) gives the author's developed relation: image, complex, archetypal dynamics and symbol have different offices; the changed interpreter conditions what a later symbol can do. The native `X/x` and `x→X→x` reading belongs to Taylor.

The return is thus neither erasure nor automatic restoration of equilibrium. A previous determination becomes an intelligible condition of the next one. The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/HISTORY.md) retains the dated psychological traditions, while the whole field's second-circuit case specifies an Offered technical test. A demonstrated psychological or computational result still needs its own evidence.

The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** recognition through the distinct scopes of ego, complex and symbolic totality. Its institutional comparison also returns a qualification at register 3: a changed psychic relation does not itself redistribute an office’s power, while an institutional change need not dissolve the affect sustaining it. Anamnesis keeps both histories effective.

## Institutional return and the evidence still required

[Ostrom's 2009 lecture, published in 2010](../../sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture.md), supplies two exact source contributions. At printed p. 422, affected users' participation in making and modifying rules belongs with recognition of local rule-making and nested governance. At p. 423, the warning against rigid transplantation includes an account of initial principles that had failed to distinguish ecological from social conditions. The source therefore supports a revisable institutional vocabulary, not the imposition of one pattern on every case.

The [technology and institutions history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/HISTORY.md) retains the route to actual governance episodes. To establish an E2 historical return, a case must identify the first rule, its selecting office, the consequence for an affected party, the counter-evidence or challenge, the authority that could respond, and the resulting determination. A second use must show what was retained and what changed. A list of design principles is not itself such a case.

The technical branch has a distinct contemporary source. [Agentworld](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md) describes intelligence distributed through rules, roles and procedures, and proposes shared decision-procedural grammar with sufficiently divergent world-models. Its prediction-stability account of trust is scoped, and its composite scenarios retain their p. 53 modal rider. E2's demand that challenge reach the evaluator or commission is the essay's extension. The paired evaluator case in the [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) remains Offered until actually executed.

The [technology–politics development](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** the difference between disclosure and changed jurisdiction. Its institutions, training procedures and commons proposal retain their dates and evidence classes. At register 3, a returned cost or correction must identify the rule, evaluator or commission it can change; the existence of a design report does not complete that intervention.

The [Foucault lens](../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/foucault/foucault-1976-history-sexuality-v1/foucault-1976-history-sexuality-v1.md#foucault-commission-return) **qualifies** institutional return at register 3: permission to speak and power to revise what speech counts as are different relations. A complaint can enter a record without reaching the office authorised to change its frame. The selected volume’s modern European analysis gives this comparison a situated source; it neither establishes a universal history of arbitration nor supplies Taylor’s native derivation.

## Register 4 and the return to the whole

The protected dramatic compression—Māyā limits, perspective delineates, hybris absolutises, regard reopens, anamnesis returns—remembers the register-3 movement. Compression alone does not move it into register 4. It does not replace the six generated relations or supply a common root. Graphic or phonic re-entry may become useful when an authorially declared relation earns it; no additional sound-play is introduced here.

Every branch returns through its exact office: lexical witness to attested sense; a dated institutional act to its consequence; comparative philosophy to its distinct claim and transformation; poetic re-entry to the relation it lets the reader remember. The [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) holds these returns together while leaving their evidence distinguishable.
